intent: Record as reviewed rules ten account-lifecycle and packaging behaviors that the code enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context identity and get-context packaging return the rules as reviewed, each citing the enforcing code.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Emails are compared trimmed and lower-cased, so a live account's email cannot be taken again.
A repeated deletion request keeps its original time.
A deletion request on a purging account is refused.
An account with a Run still cleaning up is deferred, not purged.
A purge whose file removal fails changes no row.
A taken-down Skill is refused as taken_down whatever else is true of it.
An unknown redistribution value is refused as license_unknown.
A hold applied after packaging makes the content route answer 404.
Credential files are excluded as credential_file.
A bundle with a non-redistributable member is refused with 422 naming it.
The approval that makes the records reviewed is checkable outside the package.
